name: Federal experience counted as equivalent state experience
mechanism: EO directs central HR to treat federal experience as equivalent; MQs cite equivalent federal titles; GenAI matching of qualifications.
scale_or_evidence: PA: ~120 hires by 2025-05, >800 by 2026-03, 1,350 by 2026-08; no environmental-agency breakdown published.
emst_implication: Build a versioned OPM-series-to-state-class crosswalk (with FH) and publish its confidence; offer it to PA as validation partner.

name: Expedited hiring portals for displaced federal workers
mechanism: Targeted portals and fast-track timelines (HI 14 days; MD expedited single application).
scale_or_evidence: NY: 1,300 applications and 28 hires in the first month. Targeted roles skew to HR, IT, health and engineering.
emst_implication: Environmental roles are not explicitly routed; EMST can supply the missing role matching.

name: Intergovernmental Personnel Act assignments
mechanism: Temporary assignment without change of employer [J].
scale_or_evidence: No usage data retrieved this session.
emst_implication: Use EMST role variants to justify and scope IPA assignments; record as a mobility edge type.

name: Good Neighbor Authority and Shared Stewardship staffing
direction: federal->state (work), state staff on federal land
mechanism: State agencies perform federal restoration and timber work under agreement [J].
scale_or_evidence: OpenLMP: 9 plan components mention Good Neighbor and 12 shared stewardship (vs 726 naming state/local entities).
emst_implication: Model a 'state staff, federal land' role variant; don't rely on plan text to size it.

name: Interagency wildland fire qualifications and mutual aid
mechanism: Common position qualifications recognized by all dispatching agencies [J].
scale_or_evidence: Not retrieved this session (FH/FC lane).
emst_implication: The template for portable proficiency evidence; EMST should emulate qualification records that travel with the person.

name: Federal environmental review assigned to state staff
mechanism: State DOT staff prepare and review CEQA and NEPA documents subject to FHWA review.
scale_or_evidence: Caltrans Environmental Scientist postings (2025, 2026).
emst_implication: Dual-regime environmental review is a single role variant needing both federal and state statecraft enactments.

name: State oversight of local program delivery
mechanism: State specialists hold technical authority over county staff (WI DATCP over county land conservation departments).
scale_or_evidence: WI Environmental Specialist spec.
emst_implication: Add 'oversee delegated or local program delivery' tasks; a natural state-county mobility corridor.

name: Native lateral-transfer lists
mechanism: NY CSL 70.1 lists; MN posting equivalents; PA cross-media qualifying titles.
scale_or_evidence: NY EPS 2 accepts 7 related titles incl. Forester 2 and Climate Policy Analyst 2; PA Oil and Gas compliance accepts Sanitarian, Air, Solid Waste and Water Quality Specialists.
emst_implication: Ingest as state-validated adjacency edges for CM's transferability metrics.

name: Military-to-state class crosswalk
mechanism: Statutory crosswalk published with the state classification plan.
scale_or_evidence: TX SAO military crosswalk for Natural Resources classes (rev. 2025-09-01).
emst_implication: Governance precedent and seed data for EMST state crosswalks.

name: Consultant and applicant-side mirror roles
mechanism: State regulators review consultant work (TX EPS II); private consultants prepare the applications state staff review.
scale_or_evidence: TX EPS series; CA Caltrans duties.
emst_implication: Pair regulator and applicant variants of the same function (permit writer vs permit preparer) for PS and CM.

name: Conservation corps to entry-level natural resource classes
mechanism: State staff supervise youth corps crews.
scale_or_evidence: WA NRS 5 spec.
emst_implication: Foundational-level evidence from corps service should count as qualifying experience.

name: Pay compression or inversion
mechanism: Federal average pay ranges from 77% (NY) to 183% (MD) of state pay.
scale_or_evidence: Stateline 2025 (method not stated).
emst_implication: Friction attribute on role-variant pairs, varying by state.

name: Retirement-system non-portability
mechanism: Separate DB plans, vesting and limited service-credit purchase [J].
scale_or_evidence: Not retrieved this session.
emst_implication: Friction attribute; flag mid-career moves as high-cost.

name: Civil-service status and eligible-list gates
mechanism: Appointment requires list eligibility, permanent competitive status or transfer eligibility, beyond meeting MQs.
scale_or_evidence: CA Water Board posting eligibility modes; NY transfers need permanent competitive service; NY HELPS bypass.
emst_implication: Meeting EMST competency levels is necessary but not sufficient; model the appointment route.

name: Divergent degree regimes for the same work
mechanism: Same function needs a degree in CA, MI and TPWD but not in MN, PA or FL classes.
scale_or_evidence: Sample: 16 of 70 classes degree-required, 19 substitutable, 7 not required, 10 agency- or recruitment-set.
emst_implication: Crosswalk records must carry degree rule and substitution formula per class.

name: Licensure scope and reciprocity
mechanism: PE, PG/GIT, WA LG/LEG/LHG, CA REHS and pest control licenses split classes and limit duties; operator grade reciprocity varies [J].
scale_or_evidence: TX Engineering Specialist cannot perform PE duties; WI 2017 Act 111.
emst_implication: Licensure as a first-class entity with jurisdiction and reciprocity.

name: Hiring time and exam cadence
mechanism: State hiring averages 90 days and local 136; one NY DEC page reports the last EPS exam in 2007.
scale_or_evidence: Stateline 2025; NY DEC page (stale).
emst_implication: Speed is a bigger barrier than qualification fit for displaced workers.

name: Residency requirements
mechanism: In-state residency required for some state jobs.
scale_or_evidence: PA DEP posting.
emst_implication: Friction attribute.

name: Bargaining-unit change on transfer
mechanism: Moving between classes can change unit, contract and seniority; shadow classes duplicate titles by unit.
scale_or_evidence: WA WPEA shadow classes; MN units 207/216/220.
emst_implication: Map shadow classes to one role variant; record unit as context.

name: Perceived non-transferability of federal experience
mechanism: Workers report being told 20 years of government experience isn't transferable; 'not a one-to-one match'.
scale_or_evidence: Stateline worker quotes (2025).
emst_implication: The core user problem EMST solves: make task-level overlap visible.

name: Federal funding volatility for state positions
mechanism: State environmental positions co-funded by federal grants are exposed to federal budget changes [J].
scale_or_evidence: Not quantified this session.
emst_implication: Dated driver events in L5 (FS/LM).
